evals.prompt: I want my Spice app to let users ask natural language questions about our data and get answers back. Like 'how many orders last month?' and it runs the right SQL. How do I set this up?
evals.expected_output: Configure a model with tools: auto to enable SQL tool, use /v1/nsql endpoint or /v1/chat/completions with tool use

assertions.name: configures_model_with_tools
assertions.description: Should enable tools on the model

evals.prompt: I want my chatbot to remember conversation context between sessions. How do I add memory to a Spice model?
evals.expected_output: Add memory dataset (from: memory:store) with read_write access, add memory to tools list

assertions.name: sets_read_write_access
assertions.description: Should set read_write access on memory dataset

assertions.name: adds_memory_tool
assertions.description: Should add memory to tools list

evals.prompt: We want to use GPT-4o as our primary model but fall back to Claude if OpenAI is down. How do I configure model failover in Spice?
evals.expected_output: Configure both models, then create a worker with type: load_balance and ordered routing

assertions.name: configures_worker
assertions.description: Should configure a worker for routing

assertions.name: shows_ordering
assertions.description: Should show priority ordering for failover
